agents.name: check_product_recall
agents.description: Check whether a product has been recalled in the EU. Searches 46,506 official EU Safety Gate (RAPEX) alerts published since 2005 by GTIN/EAN barcode, brand and/or product name. Returns a verdict of "recalled", "possible_match" or "clear" with the matching official alerts. A "clear" verdict means no matching alert was found — it is not a safety certification.
reasons: This tool checks for product recalls in the EU, including medications, by GTIN/EAN barcode, brand, and/or product name.
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.

assessment.explanation: I found a few tools that can check for product recalls. The "check_product_recall" tool can search for recalls in the EU by barcode, brand, or product name. For US recalls, the "check_recall" and "recall_lookup" tools can search active consumer product recalls from various government agencies, including the FDA, which covers medications. Please specify the medication's name and if you are interested in EU or US recalls.
